todos.title: Create and submit XML sitemap
todos.description: Create a sitemap.xml file to help AI crawlers discover all your important pages.

steps.text: Enable sitemap.xml in your CMS or manually create sitemap.xml with the URLs of your website pages.

Submit to Google Search Console:
Select your website property from the dropdown (add and verify if not listed).
Click "Sitemaps" under the "Indexing" section in the left menu.
Enter your sitemap URL (e.g., sitemap.xml) and click Submit.
Submit to Bing Webmaster Tools (powers Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT search).
Submit to Brave Search (powers Brave Leo AI, other AI assistants).

todos.title: Add JSON-LD structured data
todos.description: Add JSON-LD structured data to www.stayshine.com.hk to help AI systems understand your content. Missing schemas: Organization, WebSite. For homepage, add Organization and WebSite schemas. For articles/blog posts, add Article schema with headline, author, and dates. Validate your markup with W3C Validator and Google Rich Results Test.

todos.title: Create llms.txt file
todos.description: Create an www.stayshine.com.hk/llms.txt file to provide explicit instructions to AI language models about how to use your content. Include your brand name, URL, citation preferences, and whether you allow summarization/training. This is a newer standard - see llmstxt.org for the specification.

todos.title: Monitor Wikipedia for brand mentions
todos.description: Wikipedia is a trusted source for AI knowledge. Search Wikipedia for your brand to check if you're mentioned. Important: Do NOT edit Wikipedia yourself (conflict of interest). If notable, consider hiring a Wikipedia consultant. Focus on creating verifiable achievements and press coverage.

todos.title: Build Stack Overflow presence
todos.description: Stack Overflow is a primary source for AI code assistants. Create a profile at Stack Overflow with your company info. Search relevant tags and answer questions helpfully. Link to your docs when directly relevant (not spam).

todos.title: Engage in relevant Reddit communities
todos.description: Reddit discussions are used by AI for understanding brand sentiment. Search Reddit for your brand, find relevant subreddits, and engage helpfully. Respond professionally to brand mentions. Important: Never spam or self-promote excessively.
